summary: A four branch Dubai clinic with 1,400 Google reviews appears to lose patients to conflicting hours and branch details.

findings.problem: Opening hours appear as Mon to Sat on one block and Mon to Sun for another branch, and JVC appears with a third version.
findings.cost: Patients may arrive when you are closed.
findings.fix: One verified hours table per branch.

findings.problem: All four branches appear to share one email, the Arjan branch appears to share the DSO phone number, and its address shows only Al Barsha South.
findings.cost: Patients cannot reach or find the branch they want.
findings.fix: Own phone, email and full address per branch.

findings.problem: The header button appears to read Book Appointment Book, and the map section appears to say Map preview loads when you scroll here.
findings.cost: Visible rendering errors make a medical brand look unfinished.
findings.fix: A clean booking button and a working map.

findings.problem: Sections and testimonials appear to repeat, and the price range appears as AED 800 to AED 25,000 with no starting price.
findings.cost: Repeats add clutter and a wide range gives no buying signal.
findings.fix: One section each and clear starting prices.
